acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

settleRound(uint256).details: Permissionless: anyone may settle after the deadline or when early settlement conditions hold. Cycle completion check `(currentRound - cycleStartRound) >= members.length` tracks the number of rounds elapsed within the current cycle (since `cycleStartRound` is set to the previous cycle's last round).

startNewCycle().details: Resets `hasWon`, `isKicked`, and cancel votes for all members. Note that any CirBTC collateral slashed in a prior cycle is not restored; previously kicked members re-enter with 0 collateral unless they call `depositCollateral()` again.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

activeMembers().notice: Number of members still eligible (not kicked and not yet won).

claimCollateral().notice: TASK-043: Claim back deposited CirBTC collateral + dividend shares from slashed defaulters

depositCollateral(uint256).notice: Deposit CirBTC security collateral explicitly for this savings club

getMemberCollateralStatus(address).notice: TASK-043: Inspect member's CirBTC collateral status

placeBid(uint256,uint256).notice: WARNING: Bids are publicly visible on-chain and can be front-run. A commit-reveal scheme would prevent this but adds complexity. Use with awareness of MEV risk.

setCollateralAmount(uint256).notice: Configure required CirBTC collateral before members join

settleRound(uint256).notice: Settle the current round, awarding the pot to the highest bidder (or refunding if no bids).

startNewCycle().notice: Start a new Tontine cycle on the same club after COMPLETED so members can continue contributing.
